$Comment: Barebones AH-style livestock template used to demonstrate optional Tamework patches. This file intentionally avoids Tamework builders; Server/Tamework/Patches/Examples/Tamework_Example_Patch.json adds them when Tamework is installed.

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display.

ParticleOffset.Description: The offset of spawned particle systems.

MaxSpeed.Description: The maximum walking speed of the NPC.

MaxHealth.Description: The maximum health of the NPC.

MaxRotationSpeed.Description: The maximum rotation speed, in degrees per second.

RunThreshold.Description: The speed ratio at which the NPC switches to run animation.

ClimbHeight.Description: The maximum climb height, in blocks.

WanderRadius.Description: The wander radius of the NPC.

ViewRange.Description: The view distance of the NPC, in blocks.

ViewSector.Description: The view sector of the NPC, in degrees.

HearingRange.Description: The hearing distance of the NPC, in blocks.

AbsoluteDetectionRange.Description: The range at which a target is guaranteed to be detected.

AttitudeGroup.Description: The attitude group this NPC belongs to.

PlayerDefaultAttitude.Description: The default attitude towards the player.

FlockArray.Description: The set of NPCs belonging to this flock type.

LovedItems.Description: Food items accepted by Tamework interactions after patching.

FoodItemIDs.Description: Food items used by needs-seek food behavior after patching.

DayTimeNapWeight.Description: Weight for daytime naps. Set to 0 to disable.

DayFlavorAnimation.Description: Daytime flavor animation. Empty to disable.

NightFlavorAnimation.Description: Nighttime flavor animation. Empty to disable.

IsHarvestable.Description: Whether this NPC can be harvested after patching.

HarvestInteractionContext.Description: The interaction context of the harvest tool.

HarvestDropList.Description: The drop list executed when the NPC is harvested.

HarvestParticles.Description: The particle system spawned when the NPC is harvested.

HarvestSound.Description: The sound that plays when the NPC is harvested.

IsMountable.Description: Whether this NPC can be mounted after patching.

MountMode.Description: Set to TameworkMountedGlide to use the clean-slate glide mount controller.

MountGlideState.Description: State used while this NPC is ridden by the Tamework mounted glide controller.

MountGlideController.Description: Motion controller used by the Tamework mounted glide controller.

BreathesInWater.Description: Whether this NPC can breathe underwater.

MasterTargetSlot.Description: Target slot used to store the owner/master after patching.

SpawnerEmptyItemID.Description: Item IDs that can pick up this NPC after patching.

CanFollow.Description: Whether command-driven Follow behavior is enabled after patching.

CanHold.Description: Whether command-driven Hold behavior is enabled after patching.

CanDefend.Description: Whether Defend behavior is enabled after patching.

CanAttackTarget.Description: Whether Attack Target commands are allowed after patching.

CanMoveToLocation.Description: Whether Move To Location command behavior is enabled after patching.

CanReturnHome.Description: Whether Return Home command behavior is enabled after patching.

CanRecall.Description: Whether Recall command behavior is enabled after patching.

CanSetHome.Description: Whether Set Home commands are available after patching.

CanBreedPair.Description: Whether breeding pair approach behavior is enabled after patching.

TestTameItemsParam.Description: Items accepted by the example Tame interaction after patching.

TestFeedItemsParam.Description: Items accepted by the example Feed interaction after patching.

MotionControllerList.$Comment: Dormant mounted glide controller used when MountMode is TameworkMountedGlide.

Instructions.$Comment: Mounted glide steering while the NPC is being ridden.
